set -eu

# hvir-native-package-command-v1

case "$(/usr/bin/uname -s)" in
Linux)
  application='/opt/hvir/hvir'
  ;;

  application='/Applications/hvir.app/Contents/MacOS/hvir'
  ;;
*)
  echo 'hvir: the installed command is available only on Linux and macOS' >&2
  exit 69
  ;;
esac

if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
  case "$1" in
  -*)
    # Smoke and Chromium switches are explicit internal options.
    ;;
  *)
    caller_directory=$(pwd -P)
    case "$1" in
    /*) project_candidate=$1 ;;
    *) project_candidate=$caller_directory/$1 ;;
    esac
    if [ ! -d "$project_candidate" ]; then
      echo "hvir: project is not a local directory: $1" >&2
      exit 64
    fi
    project_root=$(CDPATH= cd -P "$project_candidate" && pwd -P)
    shift
    set -- "--project-root=$project_root" "$@"
    ;;
  esac
fi

exec "$application" "$@"

name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'epic/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  release-version-integrity:
    name: Release version integrity
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
      github.actor == 'github-actions[bot]' &&
      github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'github-actions[bot]' &&
      github.event.pull_request.base.ref == github.event.repository.default_branch &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      startsWith(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'release/v')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read

    steps:
      - name: Check out trusted release validation
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |-
            scripts/validate-release-pr.mts
            scripts/release-github-evidence.mts
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Validate version-only release change
        env:
          GITHUB_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          RELEASE_PR_MODE: pre-merge
          RELEASE_PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: node scripts/validate-release-pr.mts

  verify:
    name: Verification (Linux)
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      issues: read
      pull-requests: read

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          # Architecture validates the exact event base/head and accepted epic history.
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run policy, type, and test verification
        env:
          HVIR_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: npm run verify

  electron-smoke:
    name: Electron smoke (Linux)
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run production Electron workflow
        env:
          HVIR_SMOKE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts/production
        run: xvfb-run -a npm run smoke

      - name: Run development renderer Performance Timeline containment
        env:
          HVIR_SMOKE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts/development-performance
        run: xvfb-run -a npm run smoke:development-performance

      - name: Prove failure and interruption isolation
        run: xvfb-run -a npm run smoke:isolation

      - name: Upload bounded Electron failure evidence
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ci-electron-smoke-failure-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

  macos-electron-smoke:
    # Temporary reduced gate: terminal-presentation, terminal-lifecycle, and capacity
    # remain available through local commands while their macOS flakes are hardened.
    name: Electron correctness (macOS arm64; temporary reduced gate)
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

**hvir** is a desktop workbench for developing with terminals, coding agents, and local or remote projects. It combines a multi-terminal workspace, file browser and viewer, Git tools, web panes, and agent-session management in one Electron application.

## Features

- Open and switch between multiple projects and Git worktrees.
- Work on local directories or SSH hosts configured on the machine.
- Run split terminal sessions with persistent workspaces, search, recovery, and attention indicators.

- Customize terminal themes, fonts, appearance, keybindings, Git behavior, and harness profiles.
- Export diagnostic evidence from the built-in workbench health tools.

- **Node.js 24 or newer** and npm
- **Git** for repository and worktree features
- A supported desktop environment:
  - macOS
  - Linux

```bash
git clone <repository-url>
cd hvir
npm ci
npm run dev
```

`npm ci` rebuilds the Electron native runtime dependencies used by terminal sessions and file operations. The development command starts Electron and the renderer with hot reload.

```bash
hvir /path/to/project

npm run dev                  # Start the development application

npm run lint                 # Run ESLint
npm run format:check         # Check formatting
npm run typecheck            # Check main/preload and renderer types
npm run verify               # Run architecture, policy, lint, type, and test checks
npm run smoke                # Build and run the Electron smoke scenarios
```

Platform packages can be built with:

```bash
npm run pack:mac:arm64
npm run pack:linux:x64
npm run pack:linux:arm64
```

Package output is written to `dist/`. macOS releases use PKG packaging; Linux releases use DEB packaging.

## Project structure

```text
src/main/       Electron main process, local/SSH hosts, Git, terminals, diagnostics
src/preload/    Restricted, typed renderer IPC bridge
src/renderer/   React user interface and renderer-side workflows
src/shared/     Shared types, policies, and IPC contracts
src/workers/    Background worker entry points
scripts/        Verification, smoke, release, packaging, and maintenance tooling
test/           Unit, integration, architecture, and smoke scenario tests
packages/       Local native packages
build/          Icons and platform packaging resources
```

- The application enforces architecture import boundaries and automated policy checks; changes crossing process or module seams may require corresponding shared contracts and tests.
- The test suite includes local fixtures and does not require an agent account. Live SSH acceptance tests are separate and require explicitly configured hosts.
